title: Deeper/broader independent-reader maturity, ACIS API consistency, and FreeCAD conversion target
mode: Primary project documentation/source review; research-only plan update
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Screen an additional specification-first DWG implementation for useful operation- and version-scoped comparison evidence.
Reconcile current ezdxf ACIS API declarations with its FAQ so SAB capabilities are not inferred from contradictory documentation alone.
Inspect the live FreeCAD DWG wrapper to bind platform qualification to its actual converter target and intermediate DXF route.
Refine existing PAR-07/S8 and external qualification admission without adding findings, dependencies, fixtures, or support claims.

method.kind: Read-only review of project primary sources and local plan/status
method.limitations: Mutable project documentation is route-scoping evidence only. No peer behavior, local defect, native acceptance, ACIS semantic result, or external-only item was independently qualified by this pass.

sources.observed: The pre-alpha Apache-2.0 implementation separates container/object-stream maturity from per-entity decode and reports per-version decoded/skipped/error counts over a small corpus. Its page contains an aggregate-rate inconsistency (88.0% in the detailed table versus 95.6% in the adjacent capability summary) and says DXF parsing, graph completion, and external CAD acceptance remain incomplete.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Self-reported, mutable project status with small denominators; useful as an optional parser-lineage and evidence-method reference, not an interoperability result or support vote.

sources.observed: The current DWG wrapper composes an external converter with a selected DXF importer; its ODA branch requests ACAD2000 DXF and the inspected code treats expected output-file existence as success without checking the process exit status. The documentation repository is archived, and its generic 1:1 claim coexists with explicit route and entity exclusions.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Source-level route contract, not a Linux/Windows runtime result. Requires exact converter, actual intermediate version/hash, importer/backend, settings, process outcome, and per-source object disposition for any qualification.

sources.observed: The ACIS API documents SAT and SAB export methods and version constraints while warning that unsupported nodes may be lost; the FAQ says ezdxf only writes SAT, creating a documentation conflict that must be resolved against a pinned runtime and exact profile.
sources.evidenceCeiling: API/documentation capability declaration, not an executed SAB result, kernel semantic evidence, DWG AcDs ownership proof, or full B-rep qualification.

existingOwners: ACIS carrier versus parser versus kernel semantic qualification
assessment.planEffect: Bind FreeCAD qualification to the current ODA ACAD2000 DXF target and actual intermediate; separate this route from direct modern-DXF tests. Treat dwg-rs metrics as per-version, low-denominator optional evidence and resolve ezdxf SAB documentation conflict with a pinned runtime check only if selected.
